title: Discard every concatenated source value before thenMany emits its tail
summary: thenMany emitted only the tail after successful concatenation. When the second source failed, the identical error reached the subscriber without an earlier value or a tail subscription.

change.description: The merged Flux.thenMany discards the complete receiver’s values before subscribing to the supplied publisher. The old concatenation shortcut discarded values from only the last constituent.

notes: The receiver’s completion is the condition for starting the tail. An error terminates that receiver even after earlier values.
